tables.name: knowledge_categories
tables.purpose: 分类树；平台提供四个默认分类，教师可新建私有分类

fields.name: owner_id
fields.desc: 教师分类必填，平台分类为 NULL

fields.name: source_type
fields.desc: 映射的来源类型；自定义分类可为 NULL

fields.name: is_system
fields.desc: 平台内置分类，不可删改

constraints.name: ck_knowledge_categories_scope_owner
constraints.expr: (scope = 'platform' AND owner_id IS NULL) OR (scope = 'teacher' AND owner_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: ck_knowledge_categories_source_type
constraints.expr: source_type IS NULL OR source_type IN ('textbook','workbook','gaokao_paper','mock_exam','other')

tables.name: knowledge_sources
tables.purpose: 来源身份与归属；一本书或一套卷子一条

fields.name: derived_from_source_id
fields.desc: 教师复制平台来源时指向原来源

constraints.name: ck_knowledge_sources_scope_owner
constraints.expr: (scope = 'platform' AND owner_id IS NULL) OR (scope = 'teacher' AND owner_id IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: knowledge_document_versions
tables.purpose: 文件版本；解析、审核、索引挂在版本上

fields.name: parse_schema_version
fields.desc: 解析产物 Schema 版本

policies.name: pol_knowledge_document_versions_read
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_sources s WHERE s.id = source_id AND (s.scope = 'platform' OR s.owner_id = public.app_current_user_id()))

policies.name: pol_knowledge_document_versions_write
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_sources s WHERE s.id = source_id AND (s.scope = 'platform' OR s.owner_id = public.app_current_user_id()))
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_sources s WHERE s.id = source_id AND (s.scope = 'platform' OR s.owner_id = public.app_current_user_id()))

tables.name: knowledge_chunks
tables.purpose: 文本块；Citation 的定位单元

fields.name: parse_schema_version
fields.desc: 解析产物 Schema 版本

policies.name: pol_knowledge_chunks_read
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_document_versions d JOIN knowledge_sources s ON s.id = d.source_id WHERE d.id = document_version_id AND (s.scope = 'platform' OR s.owner_id = public.app_current_user_id()))

policies.name: pol_knowledge_chunks_write
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_document_versions d JOIN knowledge_sources s ON s.id = d.source_id WHERE d.id = document_version_id AND (s.scope = 'platform' OR s.owner_id = public.app_current_user_id()))
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_document_versions d JOIN knowledge_sources s ON s.id = d.source_id WHERE d.id = document_version_id AND (s.scope = 'platform' OR s.owner_id = public.app_current_user_id()))

tables.name: knowledge_questions
tables.purpose: 题目单元；检索与引用的最小单位

policies.name: pol_knowledge_questions_read
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_document_versions d JOIN knowledge_sources s ON s.id = d.source_id WHERE d.id = document_version_id AND (s.scope = 'platform' OR s.owner_id = public.app_current_user_id()))

policies.name: pol_knowledge_questions_write
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_document_versions d JOIN knowledge_sources s ON s.id = d.source_id WHERE d.id = document_version_id AND (s.scope = 'platform' OR s.owner_id = public.app_current_user_id()))
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_document_versions d JOIN knowledge_sources s ON s.id = d.source_id WHERE d.id = document_version_id AND (s.scope = 'platform' OR s.owner_id = public.app_current_user_id()))

tables.name: knowledge_annotations
tables.purpose: 派生标注；带版本，不覆盖历史

constraints.name: ck_knowledge_annotations_model_version
constraints.expr: classification_source <> 'model' OR model_version IS NOT NULL

policies.name: pol_knowledge_annotations_owner
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_questions  JOIN knowledge_document_versions ON knowledge_document_versions.id = knowledge_questions.document_version_id JOIN knowledge_sources ON knowledge_sources.id = knowledge_document_versions.source_id WHERE knowledge_questions.id = question_id AND knowledge_sources.owner_id = public.app_current_user_id())
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_questions  JOIN knowledge_document_versions ON knowledge_document_versions.id = knowledge_questions.document_version_id JOIN knowledge_sources ON knowledge_sources.id = knowledge_document_versions.source_id WHERE knowledge_questions.id = question_id AND knowledge_sources.owner_id = public.app_current_user_id())

policies.name: pol_knowledge_question_embeddings_owner
policies.using: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_questions  JOIN knowledge_document_versions ON knowledge_document_versions.id = knowledge_questions.document_version_id JOIN knowledge_sources ON knowledge_sources.id = knowledge_document_versions.source_id WHERE knowledge_questions.id = question_id AND knowledge_sources.owner_id = public.app_current_user_id())
policies.with_check: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_questions  JOIN knowledge_document_versions ON knowledge_document_versions.id = knowledge_questions.document_version_id JOIN knowledge_sources ON knowledge_sources.id = knowledge_document_versions.source_id WHERE knowledge_questions.id = question_id AND knowledge_sources.owner_id = public.app_current_user_id())
